e.title: Healthcare Count Models Lab
e.summary: 医疗/精算定价计数模型教学笔记本（heavytails 作者）：Poisson 起步到更优模型的完整路线
e.body:
Healthcare Count Models Lab 是 notebook-first 的教学仓库（DiogoRibeiro7，heavytails 作者）：讲解医疗与精算定价中的计数建模——从 Poisson 回归起步，展示真实医疗组合为什么需要更好的模型（过度离散、零膨胀等）。对 RIAA：理赔频率/计数建模的系统化教学路线。与 [[claim-frequency]]（DAV 定价）、[[cplm]]（复合泊松）、[[tweedie]]（Tweedie）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[machine-learning-pricing]]。

## 同类工具
[[huggingfacer]]、[[iblm]]、[[ibm-dppm]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_hk: 醫療/精算定價計數模型教學筆記本（heavytails 作者）：Poisson 起步到更優模型的完整路線
e.body_en:
Healthcare Count Models Lab is a notebook-first teaching repository (DiogoRibeiro7, author of heavytails): teaching count modelling in healthcare and actuarial pricing — starting with Poisson regression, then showing why real healthcare portfolios often require better models (overdispersion, zero-inflation, etc.). For RIAA: a systematic teaching path of claims-frequency/count modelling. Complements [[claim-frequency]] (DAV pricing), [[cplm]] (compound Poisson) and [[tweedie]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[machine-learning-pricing]].

## Similar tools
[[huggingfacer]]、[[iblm]]、[[ibm-dppm]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
